column1: # tests/ci/measured_growth.tsv -- per-cell seconds of the `growth` kind.  HAND-DERIVED from run 44931033374 (2026-11-21,
# cloud/main/growth/growcloud-proof, 11 shards of the first table), NOT written by cloud_measure.py: the four shards that finished
# (1, 2, 5, 10; 482 cells) each recorded units.tsv = CLI + both library passes per cell, summed over runs; the CLI jobs run two at a
# time, so each shard's units were scaled by (shard wall - 70 s setup - 120 s ASan build) / sum(units), factors 0.74-0.83. basis
# `apportioned` = an ESTIMATE until a run records the cell itself. The other seven shards hit the 45-minute limit in the ASan library
# pass and left no library seconds. Runner: AMD EPYC 7763 / 9V74 and Intel Xeon 8573C / 6975P-C, 4 cpus, gcc 15.2.0 (Ubuntu 15.2.0-16ubuntu1).
